3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: It was late in the evening as I made my way downstairs to meet Manus Sazon.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: He pulled a notepad out of his breast pocket.

7.speaker: Manus Sazon
7.text: "I want to go over the RPP's main points to get a sense of your perspective."

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "I agree. The monarch should act as the head of state, not the head of government."

10.speaker: Manus Sazon
10.text: "Our country is still an absolute monarchy in all but name. Your father created the House of Delegates as a symbolic parliament, but the new constitution can give it the true authority it represents."

11.speaker: Manus Sazon
11.text: "After all, a constitutional monarch does not rule, Your Majesty -- they merely reign."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "I disagree. Even with an empowered parliament, the monarch should retain substantial powers over the government."

13.speaker: Player_Romus
13.text: "You are not thinking radically enough, Mr. Sazon. I don't believe the monarch should reign at all."

14.speaker: Manus Sazon
14.text: "I know we had this conversation. But I remain convinced that Rizian society will not accept such a drastic change. Maybe someday."

15.speaker: Manus Sazon
15.text: "The constitution has to balance the power structure fairly so that no branch has complete authority over the other. That includes the Royal Family."

17.speaker: Manus Sazon
17.text: "Firstly, the constitution will define the House of Delegates as the governing legislative body in Rizia, with clearly outlined procedures and jurisdiction."

18.speaker: Manus Sazon
18.text: "Instead of the monarch, they will be in charge of managing the government budget and passing laws."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Only if their decisions are subject to the monarch's -- to *my* -- approval."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "Only if the monarch holds the right to veto their decisions."

23.speaker: Manus Sazon
23.text: "Hm... We can propose that the monarch can exercise the act of royal assent to approve of legislature. But a procedure must be defined so that the monarch cannot block every single piece of legislature at whim."

24.speaker: Manus Sazon
24.text: "Hm... We can propose a veto process. But it must be defined in a way that doesn't allow the monarch to block every single piece of legislature at whim."

25.speaker: Manus Sazon
25.text: "Our main objective is to ensure the political participation of our citizens. This is only possible if the monarch's power is limited, as enshrined in the constitution."

26.speaker: Manus Sazon
26.text: "We can discuss the exact details later."

27.speaker: Manus Sazon
27.text: "Secondly, we must decide whether to keep the old regional structure in Rizia or centralize the system in Porte Drazon completely."

28.speaker: Manus Sazon
28.text: "Keeping the provinces semi-autonomous may embolden their leadership to go against the new government's laws. But the nobles in those provinces have held power for centuries. They will not easily accept centralization."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "I'd rather not disturb the regional system. We should respect the autonomy of the provinces and make sure each is represented fairly."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Rizia still resembles a feudal state. We should find ways to abolish that."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "In a system that already has several branches of government and many actors, a decentralized structure will only bring instability. I support centralization."

36.speaker: Manus Sazon
36.text: "A centralized government might run more efficiently, but citizens in those provinces may see it as a slight against ancient regional traditions."

37.speaker: Manus Sazon
37.text: "However, it raises questions regarding how the provinces should be structured in such a system."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "The regions should have no autonomy or separate political structures. There must be equality among them, and laws must be implemented in a uniform way nationwide."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "While we should strive for each region to be represented in the House of Delegates, the nation of Rizia must be ruled by its parliament alone."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "It might be unpopular, but this is my vision for the kingdom."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "Each region should function as a state, and be allowed to exercise autonomy within a constitutionally defined framework."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "We should respect the historical, financial and demographical differences of the regions. Especially when it comes to each province's governing House. We need their collaboration if we want to change the system."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "I wouldn't change anything drastic. Keeping the current decentralized system will only increase public participation."

44.speaker: Manus Sazon
44.text: "We can offer the nobility something, I'm sure."

49.speaker: Manus Sazon
49.text: "If the regions retain a degree of autonomy, their local governments will share power and responsibility with the central one."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "In a federal system such as this, having a second legislative body representing the provinces might be ideal. We could form an upper House."

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "We need to give something to the nobility for their support. We could have an upper House composed exclusively of nobles."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "The legislative body should be unicameral. Complicating the system will only make it less efficient."

53.speaker: Manus Sazon
53.text: "Abolishing the regional power structure would vest all powers in the hands of the central government. In a system such as this, I believe having a unicameral legislative body would be the best option."

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "I agree. Legislative responsibility must be left to one single elected parliament."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "Yes, we already have a parliament. It'll only make the system less efficient if we create a second one."

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: I flicked a switch hidden behind the shelf of bottles. It rotated to reveal an opening in the wall, which led to a series of wooden staircases.

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: I knew the perfect place in the palace to have this conversation.

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: I'd first learned about this place from my father as a kid. He'd told me it was the only place in the palace where he could feel truly alone.

61.speaker: Manus Sazon
61.text: "Your Majesty, thank you once again for agreeing to this meeting. I cannot overemphasize how much I respect your decision."

62.speaker: Manus Sazon
62.text: "This will carve your name in the annals of history not as a monarch who clung to power, but as a visionary who saw beyond the crown."

66.speaker: Manus Sazon
66.text: "I see your point. A bicameral structure makes sense."

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: He took some notes in his notebook.

68.speaker: Manus Sazon
68.text: "The judiciary interprets, defends, and applies the law in the name of the state -- and thus should be independent from other branches of government."

69.speaker: Manus Sazon
69.text: "To ensure that the executive and legislative branches don't go beyond the powers enshrined to them, the judiciary must be given the right to put a stop to government actions that they deem unconstitutional."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "I agree. Judicial independence serves to safeguard the rights and privileges provided by the constitution. It should prevent the executive and legislative branches from encroaching upon those rights."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "Fine by me. The amount of respect that people have for the law is dependent upon the judiciary's status as a politically independent entity. Politicizing it will only hurt the rule of law."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "The judiciary can't be too independent. There must be mechanisms to prevent their abuse of power. Judges can't lack accountability."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "It *should* be, yes. But it is impossible to design a system without any flaws. The judiciary is doomed to be politicized, and it is in the best interests of the country to ensure that those politics align with those of the ruling government."

75.speaker: Manus Sazon
75.text: "Yes. The judiciary's role in deciding the validity of the elections also necessitates their independence."

76.speaker: Manus Sazon
76.text: "I don't disagree. But the key is to achieve equilibrium between accountability and independence to ensure that justice is upheld."

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: He stopped for a moment to think and went through his notes.

78.speaker: Manus Sazon
78.text: "Now that I have an idea of your opinions, Your Majesty, the RPP can start drafting the new constitution in earnest."

85.speaker: Manus Sazon
85.text: "I'll be honest with you. If any House has the power to stop us, it's Azaro."

86.speaker: Manus Sazon
86.text: "But I have to warn you, it will be an uphill battle from here."

90.speaker: Manus Sazon
90.text: "Tell me your honest opinion. Will they be a threat?"

91.speaker: Manus Sazon
91.text: "Many officers of the law, as well as military personnel, are sympathetic -- if not outright loyal to -- the Azaro family."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "I can't know for sure. General Taddeus is in charge of the armed forces, and for all I know he's keeping Azaro troops in reserve for exactly this kind of scenario."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "Actually, the bulk of their forces have been destroyed in the war. I don't think they'll have the capacity to strike."

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "Don't worry. I'm giving the orders in this war. I can make sure the Azaro troops are indisposed by the time we're ready to act."
103.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Control_Skipped"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Army_Unit_Azaro_Dead"] > 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Army_Unit_Azaro_Total"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true)

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "The war is going terribly. The Azaros and their troops will have to keep their entire focus on the frontlines if they want a prayer of winning."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "We are winning the war, Manus. If Rizia emerges victorious, House Azaro will have both the means and the heroic reputation to contest us."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "We still have to be careful. Even with a war going on, the Azaros are more than capable of a coup."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "I don't think they pose a threat. They can't simply go against both the will of the people and the monarch at the same time and expect to come out on top."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "With Lucita in prison, their ability to organize is weaker than before. But we have to be careful about her father."

118.speaker: Manus Sazon
118.text: "Rizia's police and intelligence services are watching our every move, looking for the slightest excuse to crush the democratic movement."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "We won't have to worry about the police. I gave the order for our internal security forces to pull their focus away from your movement."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "I've already done a lot on that front. House Azaro no longer controls Rizia's security forces."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "They won't be able to raise an army against us. I made sure of that when I removed provincial levies."

128.speaker: Manus Sazon
128.text: "Great thinking, Your Majesty. Although the family does still hold sway across the Cardesse-Montaklar province."

129.speaker: Manus Sazon
129.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. Although this will not stop their military faction."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "I can handle Lucita. She and I have an... understanding."

138.speaker: Manus Sazon
138.text: "If you're confident you can convince her of the necessity of our reforms, that's great news."

142.speaker: Manus Sazon
142.text: "They may not have as much firepower as the Azaros, but they have royal authority on their side."

143.speaker: Manus Sazon
143.text: "Your uncle holds incredible sway in Valenqiris. Is there a risk he will marshall your House against you?"

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "My family and I are not on the best of terms as it is. They'll never accept a new constitution for Rizia."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "All Hugo cares about is that the nobility of Rizia is respected. I'll find a way to work with House Toras on this."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "If there is anyone who can claim the throne during a crisis, that's my uncle. I don't think I trust him."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Don't worry about the Toras family. They are not going to be a problem."

152.speaker: Manus Sazon
152.text: "That complicates things. You can't have them go against you."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "We don't need their support. They cannot simply fight against the democratic movement. Besides, I'm still the monarch."

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "We have to be diplomatic. I cannot reform Rizia without involving my own family."

156.speaker: Manus Sazon
156.text: "I don't know about that... But I want to trust you, Your Majesty."

157.speaker: Manus Sazon
157.text: "I will not condone violence, Your Majesty."

158.speaker: Manus Sazon
158.text: "But I'm sure there is a way to neutralize House Toras that does not involve bloodshed."

159.speaker: Manus Sazon
159.text: "I'm afraid the Rizian National Coalition will present quite the obstacle."

160.speaker: Manus Sazon
160.text: "Baroness de Rava has tolerated the growth of the reformist movement, but she will never condone it."

164.speaker: Manus Sazon
164.text: "Any more thoughts before we fully commit to this plan?"

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: He shut his notebook and looked at me.

166.speaker: Manus Sazon
166.text: "I don't expect her or the RNC to budge an inch on our reforms."

167.speaker: Manus Sazon
167.text: "This would mean the head of government will be an elected official -- who can later be officially appointed by the head of state."

168.speaker: Manus Sazon
168.text: "They will lead a cabinet of ministers, sit as a member of the House of Delegates, and determine the direction of the Rizian government on behalf of the monarch."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "I think you're too worried about all this, Manus. You should relax. I'm willing to consider any means necessary for democracy, but you don't have to involve yourself."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "Be careful, Manus. My daughter's grown quite attached to you. For her sake, I don't want anything to happen."

175.speaker: Manus Sazon
175.text: "Don't worry, Your Majesty. You can trust me."

176.speaker: Manus Sazon
176.text: "Well... I have no power to stop you from doing that."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "She is there to represent and protect the rights of the nobility. How do you plan to get her on our side?"

180.speaker: Manus Sazon
180.text: "I will reach out to you when it's time to act. You should not rock the boat until everything is finished and organized."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "Thank you. We'll see each other again."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "I greatly respect what you're doing, Manus. I hope this plan works out -- for both of our sakes as well as Rizia's future."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "I don't know how long I can keep it a secret while your movement is asking to change the system. Sooner or later, I have to make my stance known to the country."

184.speaker: Manus Sazon
184.text: "Of course. We just have to make sure the power players cannot make a move against you once that happens."

185.speaker: Manus Sazon
185.text: "It won't be long now. I promise."

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: He smiled and we shook hands.

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: At the bottom of the stairs was a cold, gloomy room with stone walls, furnished with a single table and a couple of chairs.

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "Thank *you* for your devotion to the reformist cause, Manus."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "We're here to make plans. You don't need to butter me up."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "I'm not doing this for reputation or legacy. A monarch who gives his power away will not be remembered at all. You, the reformer, will."

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: As we ascended back into the wine cellar, I thought about what I had gotten myself into.

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: I hoped I was doing the right thing for Rizia.

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "I'm not as worried about Hugo as I am about my cousin Ricardus."
202.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true) == false)

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "I arrested Hugo's only son. I wouldn't be surprised if he was plotting revenge against me as we speak."

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: He tapped the cover of his notepad.

213.speaker: Manus Sazon
213.text: "And as Lady Regent, she's very popular with some segments of the population."

220.speaker: Manus Sazon
220.text: "And as Duchess of Valenqiris, she's very popular within House Toras."

221.speaker: Manus Sazon
221.text: "And as Crown Princess, she's very popular with some segments of the population."

222.speaker: Manus Sazon
222.text: "I will reach out to you when it's time to act."

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "Good job. I hope everything works according to plan. We'll see each other very soon."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "That's a good idea. She can be instrumental in controlling the narrative. I will ask her if she wants to be involved."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "Yes. She would be a great asset. I will involve her immediately."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "Absolutely not. We're not going to involve her in this."

227.speaker: Manus Sazon
227.text: "If you think that's best, I understand."

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: The only spot of color was a pale blue pocket square on the floor. I picked it up and noticed it was embroidered with the initials M.M.

233.speaker: Manus Sazon
233.text: "Does someone else know about this location, Your Majesty?"

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "We could be compromised. Let's make this quick."

245.speaker: Manus Sazon
245.text: "This has to be a slow, gradual process, Your Majesty. Erasing the importance of the entire Royal Family will lead to societal upheaval."

246.speaker: Manus Sazon
246.text: "For now, here is what I have in mind."

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: The stairs creaked under our feet as we descended. The further down we went into this eerie, abandoned space, the greater the sense of detachment from the palace's luxurious interior.

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "Certain household staff members. But they would never rat us out."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "I wouldn't be doing this if it wasn't what Vina wanted."

256.speaker: Manus Sazon
256.text: "The Crown Princess has inspired us both, Your Majesty."

257.speaker: Manus Sazon
257.text: "It's the only way forward, as I see it."

259.speaker: Manus Sazon
259.text: "I only wish Her Highness were here to help. Perhaps she can still be of assistance when she returns."

261.speaker: Manus Sazon
261.text: "The RPP is ready to begin drafting the new constitution."

268.speaker: Manus Sazon
268.text: "I have the greenlight from Mr. Sotelato and the RPP to begin drafting the new constitution."

272.speaker: Manus Sazon
272.text: "I'm in touch with my RPP colleagues and the leaders of the protest movements. We have the green light to begin drafting the new constitution."

273.speaker: Manus Sazon
273.text: "Unfortunately, we're still the opposition party in the House of Delegates. Meaning that if the nobles find out what we're doing, they'll fight tooth and nail to stop it."

274.speaker: Manus Sazon
274.text: "After a series of talks, they agreed to stop their calls for the abolishment of the monarchy if the constitution meets their demands."

275.speaker: Manus Sazon
275.text: "As Mr. Sotelato is now the majority speaker in the House of Delegates, he's in a very strong position to negotiate."

279.speaker: Manus Sazon
279.text: "As we briefly discussed, we will need to be very strategic about the publication and implementation of these reforms."

280.speaker: Manus Sazon
280.text: "Especially when it comes to getting them past the noble houses."

281.speaker: Manus Sazon
281.text: "However, not only does the RPP still hold a House minority, but Mr. Sotelato is now branded as a threat."

282.speaker: Manus Sazon
282.text: "As majority speaker in the House of Delegates and the heir to House Sazon, I believe I'm in a very strong position to ensure a peaceful and diplomatic resolution with the nobles."

286.speaker: Manus Sazon
286.text: "The problem is that not only is the RPP still the opposition, I've been branded a threat. Meaning that if the nobles find out what we're doing, they'll fight tooth and nail to stop it."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "We've got to get at least two of the three royal Houses to approve. I don't see how we can accomplish this otherwise."

288.speaker: Player_Romus
288.text: "If they do, we'll fight back. No one goes up against the King and lives."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "Well, that's why we're here alone in this dark damp room, aren't we?"

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: "We've got to get at least two of the three royal Houses on board. Otherwise, our reforms will be dead in the water."

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "I don't intend to include the nobles in the reform process. We already know they will never agree to it."

295.speaker: Player_Romus
295.text: "This is our best chance, Manus. We have to seize it."

296.speaker: Player_Romus
296.text: "Does that imply the existence of a *non-peaceful* resolution?"

297.speaker: Manus Sazon
297.text: "If you're referring to the use of violence, I would never agree to go that route. I refuse to follow in my father's footsteps."

298.speaker: Manus Sazon
298.text: "But that doesn't mean we have to be diplomatic with the nobility."

299.speaker: Manus Sazon
299.text: "We don't have to include the nobles in the drafting process. There are ways to ensure they won't get wind of the reforms until the ink on the constitution has dried."

302.speaker: Manus Sazon
302.text: "I'm telling you, Your Majesty. We won't even get the chance to persuade them."

303.speaker: Manus Sazon
303.text: "Declaring our reform intentions to them would make us a target. The Crown itself would be in peril."

304.speaker: Narrator
304.text: He let out a short laugh.

306.speaker: Manus Sazon
306.text: "Please, Your Majesty. All our efforts will be for nothing if they result in violence."

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "And how do we do it without them? After all, it's not possible to hide the fact that we're changing the political system from anybody."

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "Then I will make sure they won't have the capacity to put their focus against us."

311.speaker: Manus Sazon
311.text: "There is a reason why we're meeting here in secret."

312.speaker: Manus Sazon
312.text: "If we can keep the process completely under wraps until the constitution's been signed, the Houses will have no choice but to accept it."

313.speaker: Manus Sazon
313.text: "With millions of people on the streets on our side, it would be too late for any force to intervene."

317.speaker: Manus Sazon
317.text: "By the time the House of Delegates proposes the constitution, everything will already be in place. You arrive at the House with the protection of the Golden Guard and sign it with the delegates, declaring it on live broadcast nationally."

319.speaker: Manus Sazon
319.text: "I understand what you're saying, Your Majesty."

320.speaker: Manus Sazon
320.text: "We can add some concessions to the nobles in these reforms. If they're allowed to keep their titles and estates, they might be persuaded to approve."

321.speaker: Manus Sazon
321.text: "If we include the nobility in the process, they'll certainly demand to keep their estates and at least some of their power."

322.speaker: Manus Sazon
322.text: "But before we start planning how to pass our new constitution, I suggest we first discuss its contents."

323.speaker: Manus Sazon
323.text: "Therefore, before we discuss how to pass our new constitution, we must first discuss its contents."

328.speaker: Player_Romus
328.text: "With House Azaro's intelligence capabilities and House Toras' eyes and ears within the palace, maintaining total secrecy will be impossible."

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: "I disagree. Even if we do this exactly the way you describe, the nobility can still deem the new constitution illegitimate and oust me from power."

330.speaker: Manus Sazon
330.text: "It would be too late for any force to intervene."

331.speaker: Manus Sazon
331.text: "Only if they themselves have enough power and support to do so."

332.speaker: Manus Sazon
332.text: "But before we start planning how to unveil the new constitution, I suggest we first discuss its contents."

333.speaker: Manus Sazon
333.text: "Well, I wouldn't phrase it that way."

335.speaker: Manus Sazon
335.text: "The RPP will organize the reform movement while you make sure the security of Porte Drazon is not compromised."

336.speaker: Manus Sazon
336.text: "If we want a peaceful resolution to all this, we need to play it smart."

340.speaker: Manus Sazon
340.text: "However, Mr. Sotelato is not open to the idea of the nobles retaining any privilege other than the royal family of the monarch, which he agreed to respect as long as they act purely as a symbolic head of state."

344.speaker: Manus Sazon
344.text: "Mr. Sotelato will never budge on this point, Your Majesty. The monarch must reign in name only."

348.speaker: Manus Sazon
348.text: "I'm not sure about that, Your Majesty. I doubt the nobles can be convinced. Nonetheless..."

349.speaker: Manus Sazon
349.text: "We have hundreds of thousands of people rallying for change. Although we have momentum on our side, we're still in a precarious situation."

353.speaker: Manus Sazon
353.text: "We might have the people's support and hold a legitimate majority in the House of Delegates, but given the opportunity, I do not doubt the nobles will show their true colors."

354.speaker: Manus Sazon
354.text: "We would not only be going against the will of the nobles, but also that of Baroness de Rava and the House of Delegates. We have to be extremely careful."

355.speaker: Player_Romus
355.text: "Yes, definitely. They'll never agree to these reforms peacefully."

357.speaker: Player_Romus
357.text: "Without eyes or ears inside the house, I have no idea whether they're a threat or not."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "I don't know about Hugo. But I do know that my cousin Ricardus would love nothing more than to see me humiliated."
361.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true)

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "There is still time for me to get on their good side. But we have to make a plan for the worst case scenario."

370.speaker: Manus Sazon
370.text: "Unfortunately, my mother may be a problem."

371.speaker: Manus Sazon
371.text: "As the reinstated matriarch of House Sazon, she commands more respect from our family than I do."

372.speaker: Manus Sazon
372.text: "And frankly, she and I are of different minds."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "All Hugo cares about is that the nobility of Rizia is respected. If we keep Valenqiris semi-autonomous and introduce a House of Lords in parliament, he'll have nothing to complain about."

380.speaker: Manus Sazon
380.text: "She doesn't support my movement or our demands for reform. And she'll never agree with Sotelato's proposed terms."

382.speaker: Manus Sazon
382.text: "She would likely not support any constitution that doesn't respect our family as a royal house."

386.speaker: Manus Sazon
386.text: "She doesn't support my movement or our demands for reform. And she won't so much as glance at the new constitution as long as Daria and the RNC are in charge."
386.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false)

387.speaker: Manus Sazon
387.text: "I will be honest. This is a setback I wasn't prepared for, and it will make my job difficult."

388.speaker: Manus Sazon
388.text: "She has taken a staunchly monarchist stance since her arrival. I fear all those years of being punished for her husband's betrayal have gotten to her."

389.speaker: Player_Romus
389.text: "Are you sure that's where her loyalties truly lie? What if she's been a secret reformist all this time?"

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "I am the one who pardoned her. If she's truly loyal, she will support me."

391.speaker: Player_Romus
391.text: "Give it to me straight. Can you handle this yourself?"

392.speaker: Player_Romus
392.text: "If she and your kin don't fall in line, I will make them."

393.speaker: Manus Sazon
393.text: "So that has to be taken into account as well."

394.speaker: Narrator
394.text: A look of fear flashed on his face.

396.speaker: Manus Sazon
396.text: "I can't guarantee it. All I can tell you is that if House Toras and Azaro agree to the reforms, my mother's objections will count for nothing."

397.speaker: Manus Sazon
397.text: "She is loyal to the Crown. Not to the man wearing it."

399.speaker: Manus Sazon
399.text: "All I can tell you is that if House Toras or Azaro opposes the reforms, my mother will join forces with them to stop us."

400.speaker: Player_Romus
400.text: "If the very institution that you'll be empowering doesn't recognize or accept the transition, how will the constitution be put in place?"

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "And why do we care? We're already making enemies. The RNC is the least of our worries."

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "What do you mean? They are loyal to the Crown."

403.speaker: Manus Sazon
403.text: "They are a worry, Your Majesty. As the majority, they have the power to obstruct us at every turn."

404.speaker: Manus Sazon
404.text: "As the majority, the RNC has the power to obstruct us at every turn."

405.speaker: Manus Sazon
405.text: "If de Rava finds out about our plans while they're still at this early stage, she'll crush them in their tracks."

408.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
408.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true) == false

411.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
411.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false

412.speaker: Manus Sazon
412.text: "If we assume that both House Toras and House Azaro will stop at nothing to oppose our reforms..."
412.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true) and (((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

413.speaker: Manus Sazon
413.text: "You said you think you can convince House Toras and House Azaro to agree to the reforms."

414.speaker: Manus Sazon
414.text: "You don't believe that either House Azaro or House Toras will challenge our reforms."
414.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

423.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
423.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false

427.speaker: Manus Sazon
427.text: "You said you thought you could convince House Azaro to agree to the reforms."
427.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true)

428.speaker: Manus Sazon
428.text: "You said you thought you could convince House Toras to agree to the reforms."
428.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true) == false)

433.speaker: Manus Sazon
433.text: "If you succeed, we'll have the two most powerful royal houses on our side. Even if my mother disagrees, there's nothing she could do about it."

434.speaker: Manus Sazon
434.text: "But even in that case, you would need to get at least one of the other royal houses on your side. And as I mentioned, my mother won't be easy to deal with."

435.speaker: Manus Sazon
435.text: "If you succeed, and if House Sazon rallies behind me as I expect they will, we'd have two of the three royal houses on our side."

439.speaker: Manus Sazon
439.text: "If you succeed, and if House Sazon rallies behind me as I expect they will, we'll have all three royal houses on our side."

440.speaker: Manus Sazon
440.text: "That being said, we still have room to bargain. If the new constitution grants concessions to the nobles, I believe we will still be able to convince them."

441.speaker: Manus Sazon
441.text: "We've established that all three royal houses will be a threat to our reforms."
441.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

445.speaker: Manus Sazon
445.text: "If we assume House Azaro will stop at nothing to oppose our reforms..."
445.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true) and (((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true)

446.speaker: Manus Sazon
446.text: "If we assume House Toras will stop at nothing to oppose our reforms..."
446.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras"] == true) and (((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro_Talk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Toras_Talk"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Reform_Threat_Azaro"] == true) == false)

450.speaker: Manus Sazon
450.text: "...and my mother Angelica will most certainly unite House Sazon against us as well..."

451.speaker: Manus Sazon
451.text: "That leaves us in a very dangerous position."

452.speaker: Manus Sazon
452.text: "I believe taking this reform through public channels and negotiating with the royal houses is the best course of action."

453.speaker: Manus Sazon
453.text: "After all, we have a parliament majority and I have legitimacy as House Speaker. If you command the respect of the nobility as you say, this should be easy."

458.speaker: Manus Sazon
458.text: "After all, we have a parliament majority, I have legitimacy as House Speaker and a growing movement is uniting behind us. If you command the respect of the nobility as you say, this should be easy."

462.speaker: Manus Sazon
462.text: "But with the RNC holding a majority in the House of Delegates, that doesn't matter."
462.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == false)

463.speaker: Manus Sazon
463.text: "Despite this fact, I believe there's still a chance we can publicize our intention to reform and negotiate a compromise that satisfies everyone."

467.speaker: Manus Sazon
467.text: "After all, we have a parliament majority and I have legitimacy as House Speaker. Under those circumstances, bargaining with the royal houses is a definite possibility."

472.speaker: Manus Sazon
472.text: "After all, we have a parliament majority, I have legitimacy as House Speaker and a growing movement is uniting behind us. Under those circumstances, swaying the royal houses won't be difficult."

474.speaker: Player_Romus
474.text: "The nobility will strike as soon as they learn we're cooperating with the revolutionaries. I will not declare my intentions to the public. We must keep a low profile until the reforms are declared."

481.speaker: Manus Sazon
481.text: "Mr. Sotelato's movement is approaching critical mass, Your Majesty. If you publicly support it as well, the pressure on the nobility would be enormous."

482.speaker: Manus Sazon
482.text: "Much as I wish we could sit down with all parties and hammer out a peaceful compromise, I fear it's just not going to happen."

483.speaker: Manus Sazon
483.text: "But it might not be enough to stop them from organizing against you."

484.speaker: Manus Sazon
484.text: "The Rizian people are openly demanding reform, Your Majesty. If you publicly support it as well, the pressure on the nobility would be enormous."

485.speaker: Manus Sazon
485.text: "But it might not be enough to stop them from organizing against you."

486.speaker: Manus Sazon
486.text: "With our current circumstances, it would be unwise to declare your intentions to reform Rizia before the new constitution is ready."

487.speaker: Manus Sazon
487.text: "My advice would be to lay low until the time is right."

488.speaker: Player_Romus
488.text: "I honestly don't know if I have enough sway with the Royal Houses to convince them to give away their power peacefully."

489.speaker: Player_Romus
489.text: "I agree with you, Manus. The sooner we publicize our reform intentions, the sooner the transformation of Rizia can begin."

490.speaker: Player_Romus
490.text: "I know I said I could convince the nobility. But upon further reflection, I'm not so confident."

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "While I'm skeptical about declaring our reform intentions immediately, I do agree that the nobles should have a say in the new constitution."

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "The nobility will strike as soon as they learn what we're trying to do. I will not declare my intentions to the public. We must keep a low profile until the reforms are ready."

493.speaker: Player_Romus
493.text: "Once we declare our intentions, the power of the reform movement will be undeniable. There's no chance the nobles will move against us."

494.speaker: Player_Romus
494.text: "The stakes are too high to take half measures. We must strike the houses before they are ready and force our relatives to comply."

495.speaker: Player_Romus
495.text: "I agree that the nobility will strike as soon as they learn what we're trying to do. We must keep a low profile."

496.speaker: Player_Romus
496.text: "The stakes are too high to take half measures. We must organize a preemptive strike against the nobility and force them to comply."

497.speaker: Player_Romus
497.text: "I still think we should be open and diplomatic with the royal houses. As Rizia's most noble of families, they deserve a seat at the table."

502.speaker: Manus Sazon
502.text: "Even with the populace against them, there's still a chance one or more of the houses will try to strike before the constitution is signed."

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "Once the pressure has built to a significant degree, we'll invite them for negotiations. They'll fold like a second-rate poker player."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "If we have to, we will strike first."

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "You're right. It's too risky. We should be stealthy and prepare the new constitution without raising any suspicions."

508.speaker: Manus Sazon
508.text: "Then it is settled, Your Majesty. We will seek the royal houses' approval on our reforms."

509.speaker: Manus Sazon
509.text: "I will reach out to you when the time is right and we have a draft ready to discuss with them."

513.speaker: Player_Romus
513.text: "My benevolence has its limits. Sotelato's people know that without my cooperation there would be no reforms, and yet my opinion is not respected. I won't have any of it."

514.speaker: Player_Romus
514.text: "I am very serious, Manus. Our collaboration is over. You'd better stop representing this movement before it's too late as well."

515.speaker: Player_Romus
515.text: "Don't make me repeat myself. Our meeting is over."

521.speaker: Manus Sazon
521.text: "So be it, Your Majesty. Perhaps my fears are overblown."

522.speaker: Manus Sazon
522.text: "Then I will reach out to you for our next steps."

526.speaker: Manus Sazon
526.text: "Thank you for the meeting, Your Majesty."

527.speaker: Narrator
527.text: As we ascended back into the wine cellar, I thought about what I had gotten myself into.

528.speaker: Narrator
528.text: I hoped that cutting ties with the reformists had been the right move.

529.speaker: Narrator
529.text: With Pabel's help, Manus managed to make it into the Palas Rezna kitchens through a service entrance. We greeted each other in hushed voices, then headed below the kitchen to the wine cellar.

533.speaker: Narrator
533.text: With Titus' help, Manus managed to make it into the Palas Rezna kitchens through a service entrance. We greeted each other in hushed voices, then headed below the kitchen to the wine cellar.

537.speaker: Player_Romus
537.text: "Don't get too excited. All I'm trying to do is keep your party's lunatic fringe from coming for my head."

538.speaker: Manus Sazon
538.text: "But you're not going after theirs. That's a promising start."

542.speaker: Manus Sazon
542.text: "When the Crown Princess returns, it will be to a changed Rizia."

543.speaker: Manus Sazon
543.text: "On the other hand, I doubt the nobility will agree to play by his rules."

544.speaker: Manus Sazon
544.text: "The second the nobles find out we're working with him, they will try to stop us by any means necessary."

548.speaker: Manus Sazon
548.text: "The RPP may not hold a delegate majority, but as the Crowd Prince Consort, I still hold some sway with the nobles. A peaceful resolution may yet be possible."

549.speaker: Player_Romus
549.text: "A wise man once told me that violence is justified if it helps protect the divine order."

553.speaker: Player_Romus
553.text: "I agree that violence should only be used as a last resort. But it sounds like we're reaching that point."

554.speaker: Player_Romus
554.text: "I was speaking metaphorically. We'll fight them with our *words*."

555.speaker: Manus Sazon
555.text: "I was just about to tell you that we shouldn't say a word to the nobility."

557.speaker: Manus Sazon
557.text: "It doesn't have to come to that. Listen."

561.speaker: Player_Romus
561.text: "It's about time. Numbers make me dizzy."

565.speaker: Manus Sazon
565.text: "First, I want to go over the demands of Sotelato's faction to get a sense of your perspective."

566.speaker: Manus Sazon
566.text: "He and I agree that our main objective is to ensure the political participation of our citizens. This is only possible if the monarch's power is limited, as enshrined in the constitution."

567.speaker: Manus Sazon
567.text: "Our country is still an absolute monarchy in all but name. Your father created the House of Delegates as a symbolic parliament, but the new constitution can give it the true authority it represents."

568.speaker: Manus Sazon
568.text: "This would mean the head of government will be an elected official -- who can later be ceremonially appointed by the head of state."

569.speaker: Manus Sazon
569.text: "You will no longer rule, Your Majesty. But you'll reign, albeit in name only."

570.speaker: Manus Sazon
570.text: "They will lead a cabinet of ministers, sit as a member of the House of Delegates, and determine the direction of the Rizian government."

572.speaker: Player_Romus
572.text: "That sounds like far too much power for one person."

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "I don't object to any of this so far."

574.speaker: Manus Sazon
574.text: "The head of government's powers would be clearly outlined in the constitution. The goal is to balance the power structure fairly so that no branch has complete authority over the other."

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "I agree. The monarch should act as the head of state, not the head of government."

578.speaker: Manus Sazon
578.text: "Mr. Sotelato will never budge on this point."

579.speaker: Manus Sazon
579.text: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, I don't think you understand what Sotelato's movement wants."

580.speaker: Manus Sazon
580.text: "The House of Delegates itself will be defined as the governing legislative body in Rizia, with clearly outlined procedures and jurisdiction."

581.speaker: Manus Sazon
581.text: "Instead of the monarch, they will be in charge of managing the government budget and passing laws."

582.speaker: Player_Romus
582.text: "Only if their decisions are subject to the monarch's -- to *my* -- approval."

583.speaker: Player_Romus
583.text: "Only if the monarch holds the right to veto their decisions."

584.speaker: Manus Sazon
584.text: "Unless you can accept the complete transfer of your sovereignty to the House of Delegates, the new constitution will never pass."

585.speaker: Player_Romus
585.text: "I'll miss being able to sign decrees."

589.speaker: Player_Romus
589.text: "Perfect. Numbers make my head hurt anyway."

590.speaker: Manus Sazon
590.text: "If I were in charge of the RPP, I'd allow the monarch to have some sort of say in politics. Alas, I am not."

592.speaker: Player_Romus
592.text: "That's it? I was expecting much worse."

593.speaker: Manus Sazon
593.text: "I'm not finished with the list of demands."

596.speaker: Player_Romus
596.text: "That makes sense. If I don't have any power, my relatives shouldn't either."

597.speaker: Manus Sazon
597.text: "Soletato's group is asking not only for the removal of the monarch's sovereign powers, but for the removal of all political privileges from the nobility."

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "That's not fair. Some of Rizia's finest politicians are nobles."

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "Finishing the job my electoral reform decree started."

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "A slap in the face to Rizian tradition."

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "But they can keep their money, right?"

605.speaker: Manus Sazon
605.text: "Whatever's left of it after the tax hikes the new government is planning."

606.speaker: Manus Sazon
606.text: "It will make many people very angry, yes."

607.speaker: Manus Sazon
607.text: "They can run for election, like anyone else."

608.speaker: Manus Sazon
608.text: "More than that. In a few generations, the names Toras, Azaro and Sazon will mean next to nothing."

609.speaker: Manus Sazon
609.text: "I would expect nothing less from this movement. But it will make a good deal of people very angry."

610.speaker: Manus Sazon
610.text: "Finally... after the constitution is signed, an interim prime minister will have to be appointed to govern Rizia during the transitory period before the elections."

611.speaker: Manus Sazon
611.text: "The RPP's demand is for Adarfo Sotelato himself to fill that role."

612.speaker: Player_Romus
612.text: "I was fine with all the other demands. But I will not put an unproven commoner in charge of our kingdom, even temporarily. Tell the rest of your party that the plan is off."

613.speaker: Player_Romus
613.text: "If that's what it takes to get the reforms across the finish line, then I agree to all of the demands."

614.speaker: Player_Romus
614.text: "This is all your mistake for letting RPP get radicalized. I'm afraid I will not agree to their demands."

615.speaker: Player_Romus
615.text: "With terms like these, we might as well abolish the Rizian monarchy altogether."

616.speaker: Narrator
616.text: Manus broke into an enormous, relieved smile.

618.speaker: Manus Sazon
618.text: "If that is what you want, all you have to do is hand your crown to Adarfo Sotelato."

619.speaker: Manus Sazon
619.text: "I warn you, though, he might not accept it unless your head comes off with it."

621.speaker: Player_Romus
621.text: "I'm willing to take that risk. Get me a meeting with Sotelato. I should have been speaking with him this entire time."

622.speaker: Player_Romus
622.text: "It is not my intention to abdicate, Mr. Sazon. Nor is it my intention to hand over my and my family's power to some urchin from the mines."

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "I only meant to say that Sotelato's demands are extreme. But I'll agree to them."

629.speaker: Narrator
629.text: He flipped to another page in his notepad.

630.speaker: Manus Sazon
630.text: "Now that you've agreed on the basics, there are a few more details we should discuss. The RPP leadership is flexible on these."

631.speaker: Manus Sazon
631.text: "One significant decision is whether to keep the old regional structure in Rizia or centralize the system in Porte Drazon completely."

632.speaker: Manus Sazon
632.text: "Keep in mind that the royal houses will be stripped of their governing power whether Rizia is centralized or not. The new provincial leadership will have to be democratically elected."

639.speaker: Narrator
639.text: I had given up the opportunity to reform Rizia. And soon, I might be about to give up my crown.

643.speaker: Player_Romus
643.text: "A governing council is working out well for Iza. The provinces should adopt the same system."

644.speaker: Manus Sazon
644.text: "Respecting regional traditions would be a clever choice."

648.speaker: Player_Romus
648.text: "Nor will Duke Axel Reinhart. I doubt he'll agree to reunification if it means Pales losing all of its autonomy."

649.speaker: Manus Sazon
649.text: "It would be a tragedy if the Princess' arranged marriage was for nothing. Decentralization it is, then."

651.speaker: Manus Sazon
651.text: "I see. A House of Lords, so to speak."

655.speaker: Manus Sazon
655.text: "The rest of the RPP won't like it. But it's a fine compromise in my opinion."

656.speaker: Manus Sazon
656.text: "We'll have a hard time getting the nobility to agree to even that. But it's a fine compromise in my opinion."

661.speaker: Manus Sazon
661.text: "Allowing the provincial nobility to serve in this upper chamber would assuage their concerns about losing power under the new system."

664.speaker: Player_Romus
664.text: "Good thinking. The upper chamber will be a House of Lords."

665.speaker: Player_Romus
665.text: "No, I want a clean slate. The upper chamber will be composed of elected representatives for each region."

666.speaker: Manus Sazon
666.text: "A regional senate. The RPP will like that."

670.speaker: Player_Romus
670.text: "From now on, your duty is to be the Crown Prince Consort. I'll handle Sotelato."

671.speaker: Manus Sazon
671.text: "I've been thinking about the best way to deal with potential opposition from the three houses. But I want your perspective on them as the King."

673.speaker: Player_Romus
673.text: "Let's talk about my relatives in House Toras."

674.speaker: Player_Romus
674.text: "How do you think House Sazon will react to the reforms?"

679.speaker: Manus Sazon
679.text: "With that said, General Taddeus, Duchess Lucita and most Rizian troops are concentrating on the war in Pales. They might be too distracted to contest or even notice our reform attempts."

680.speaker: Player_Romus
680.text: "We don't need to worry about General Taddeus. The last time we spoke, I made sure he knew his place."

681.speaker: Manus Sazon
681.text: "That's not very reassuring. The General is an infamous holder of grudges."

682.speaker: Manus Sazon
682.text: "As long as it doesn't jeopardize Her Highness' survival."

692.speaker: Player_Romus
692.text: "He did not dare to strike back at me even after I arrested Rico. He won't be a problem."

693.speaker: Manus Sazon
693.text: "If you say so... You know your relatives better than I do, of course."

697.speaker: Player_Romus
697.text: "With my daughter about to marry his son? It'll never happen."

698.speaker: Manus Sazon
698.text: "Correct me if I'm wrong, but that marriage is meant to preserve the Toras line of succession. Which will be of significantly less importance if these reforms succeed."

699.speaker: Manus Sazon
699.text: "But let's assume for now that the coming royal wedding will put Hugo and Rico in our camp."

704.speaker: Player_Romus
704.text: "After I made his son police chief? Not a chance."
704.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == true)

705.speaker: Manus Sazon
705.text: "But Your Majesty... now that Duke Ricardus is in charge of the capital's security, he can very easily stop our reforms in their tracks."

707.speaker: Player_Romus
707.text: "He could, but he wouldn't dare. I've got him under my thumb."

714.speaker: Manus Sazon
714.text: "As the matriarch of House Sazon and the Duchess of Iza, she commands more respect from our family than I do."

720.speaker: Manus Sazon
720.text: "I am House Sazon's heir and the Crown Prince Consort. No member of my family commands more respect than I do."

721.speaker: Manus Sazon
721.text: "I am House Sazon's heir. No member of my family commands more respect than I do."

722.speaker: Manus Sazon
722.text: "My cousin Leona is little more than a figurehead. She and the others will support the reforms when the time comes."

725.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
725.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Toras"] == true) == false

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "That covers the royal houses. What about Daria and the House of Delegates?"
726.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Toras"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == false)

730.speaker: Player_Romus
730.text: "That covers the royal houses. What about your fellow Delegates?"
730.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Toras"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == false) == false)

731.speaker: Manus Sazon
731.text: "Baroness de Rava has tolerated the presence of the reformist movement in parliament, but she will never condone it."

733.speaker: Manus Sazon
733.text: "As the majority, the RNC has the power to obstruct us at every turn, with the justification the new constitution is 'against the will of the people'."

734.speaker: Manus Sazon
734.text: "The RPP is the majority party, Your Majesty. If we all support the new constitution, Daria and the RNC won't contest it."

735.speaker: Player_Romus
735.text: "It's a waste of time to talk about the houses. Let's just assume they'll never agree with this plan."
735.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Toras"] == true) == false)

736.speaker: Player_Romus
736.text: "No need to discuss the houses. They'll fall in line if I tell them to."
736.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ReformTalk_HouseThreats_Toras"] == true) == false)

737.speaker: Manus Sazon
737.text: "But Your Majesty, there is still Daria de Rava and the Rizian National Coalition to consider."

741.speaker: Manus Sazon
741.text: "I very much hope you're right about that."

742.speaker: Manus Sazon
742.text: "If the new constitution gains a delegate majority in the HOD -- which it will, because my party is in charge -- the nobles won't have the legal means to challenge us."

743.speaker: Manus Sazon
743.text: "Then again, the Rizian nobility has been known to resort to extralegal means in the past."

751.speaker: Manus Sazon
751.text: "Are you sure it's not worth trying to bargain with them?"

753.speaker: Manus Sazon
753.text: "Even if we could get the Houses on our side, Daria de Rava and the Rizian National Coalition present a significant challenge."

757.speaker: Manus Sazon
757.text: "Not to mention that Adarfo's demands leave us with little room to negotiate."

763.speaker: Manus Sazon
763.text: "I maintain they'll never allow a commoner like Adarfo Sotelato to strip them of their privileges."
763.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == false) == false)

764.speaker: Player_Romus
764.text: "If being diplomatic means making concessions to the nobility in our new constitution, I would rather not do it."

768.speaker: Manus Sazon
768.text: "We'll talk about this later. I hope we can come to an agreement regarding such an... arrangement."

770.speaker: Manus Sazon
770.text: "If and when the time comes to present her with the new constitution, she will likely expect to be named interim prime minister."

775.speaker: Player_Romus
775.text: "I thought you'd be gunning for the position yourself."

776.speaker: Player_Romus
776.text: "What does it matter? She'd only lead the country for a few months, anyway."

778.speaker: Manus Sazon
778.text: "It would be an honor, Your Majesty, but I'm not the majority speaker in parliament. If we're to play by the rules, Daria would be the correct choice."

779.speaker: Manus Sazon
779.text: "I agree. On paper, at least, she is the popular choice."

780.speaker: Manus Sazon
780.text: "Rizia naming its first prime minister will be an event with immense ramifications. Her name would go down in history."

781.speaker: Manus Sazon
781.text: "If we want to acknowledge the opposition, we could give Daria the role of interim prime minister, letting her lead the government until the first elections are held."

782.speaker: Player_Romus
782.text: "Why would I do that? You're the man the people want."

785.speaker: Player_Romus
785.text: "Why not? It might help smooth things over."

786.speaker: Manus Sazon
786.text: "And she's unlikely to make too many disruptions during that time."

787.speaker: Player_Romus
787.text: "I thought you'd be gunning for the position yourself."

788.speaker: Manus Sazon
788.text: "It would indeed be an honor, Your Majesty, but that was never why I proposed these reforms."

792.speaker: Player_Romus
792.text: "We're not going to make any drastic moves until after the royal wedding. I want it to go off without a hitch."

797.speaker: Manus Sazon
797.text: "Obviously, so do I. The profile boost I'll get as Prince Consort will be a huge help to the reformist cause."

799.speaker: Manus Sazon
799.text: "So do I, Your Majesty. We'll wait."

803.speaker: Player_Romus
803.text: "Be careful, Manus. If this goes south, we could both lose our heads."

805.speaker: Manus Sazon
805.text: "Don't worry, Your Majesty. You can trust me."

806.speaker: Player_Romus
806.text: "A communist prime minister... If that isn't the nail in the coffin for our relationship with ATO, I don't know what is."

810.speaker: Manus Sazon
810.text: "The West won't like it one bit."

811.speaker: Manus Sazon
811.text: "We -- well, Adarfo -- will have to focus on strengthening ties with Morella and Valgsland. It'll be a completely different landscape."

812.speaker: Player_Romus
812.text: "I wonder what our neighbors will think of all this."

813.speaker: Manus Sazon
813.text: "As long as we maintain the same trade ties as before, I don't see a reason why any of our international relationships would be affected."

817.speaker: Manus Sazon
817.text: "Of course, I'm hoping the Pales war will be far in our rearview mirror before the reforms pass."

819.speaker: Manus Sazon
819.text: "There is one more point I wanted to bring up. About Her Highness."

823.speaker: Manus Sazon
823.text: "If we want to be diplomatic about the reform process, I highly suggest we get Vina involved."

824.speaker: Manus Sazon
824.text: "This is something she's passionate about as well, after all."

828.speaker: Manus Sazon
828.text: "For the Princess' own protection, I'm not sure whether she should be informed about these plans until they've come to fruition."

829.speaker: Player_Romus
829.text: "This highly concerns my daughter and her future. Of course she should be informed."

834.speaker: Player_Romus
834.text: "Nonsense. You're her fiance. I don't want you keeping secrets from her."

835.speaker: Manus Sazon
835.text: "Yes, you're right. I'll tell her as soon as I can."

837.speaker: Player_Romus
837.text: "Admit it. You're worried she's going to fall for Adarfo."

843.speaker: Player_Romus
843.text: "You may be right. I don't want to put my daughter in danger."

845.speaker: Manus Sazon
845.text: "She'll be told when the time is right."

848.speaker: Manus Sazon
848.text: "In the meantime, please be careful of what information you share in front of the Golden Guard."

852.speaker: Manus Sazon
852.text: "We wouldn't want Captain Gordion to leak anything to the nobility."

853.speaker: Manus Sazon
853.text: "Please be careful of what information you share in front of the Golden Guard, Your Majesty. They can turn into a threat if we're not careful."

857.speaker: Manus Sazon
857.text: "After all, we have a parliament majority, the House Speaker is from the RPP and a growing movement is uniting behind us. If you command the respect of the nobility as you say, this should be easy."

861.speaker: Manus Sazon
861.text: "After all, we have a parliament majority and the House Speaker is from the RPP. If you command the respect of the nobility as you say, this should be easy."

862.speaker: Player_Romus
862.text: "Of course, these nobles will serve in an advisory capacity only. It will be a kind of inverse of the old system."

863.speaker: Player_Romus
863.text: "We'll give them the ability to provide some checks on the lower house, but their power will still be limited."

864.speaker: Player_Romus
864.text: "This upper house will have equal power to the lower house. I'd like to hear the nobility complain about that."
